author: high3
claim: Prove the full Vandermonde identity by induction on n, deriving a division-free recurrence through descending determinant-preserving column replacements.
evidence: Base case n=1 has determinant 1 and empty product 1. For n>=2 derive D_n=(product_{i=2}^n(x_i-x_1))D_{n-1}(x_2,...,x_n), apply the induction hypothesis to D_{n-1}, and combine the factor families to obtain all pairs 1<=i<j<=n.

glossary.D_n: the n-by-n Vandermonde determinant under discussion
